body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> ANAM instruments displayed portable T-DMB which is ready to roll out this November during KES 2006. It supports 7 channels of DMB and 13 channels of DAB with 2.2-inch QVGA TFT-LCD. It runs 5 hours of TV watching time and can save TV programs in SD card.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
